messages:
support_jen: Customer Nimbus on dedicated pool reserved-west-3-quiet seeing intermittent 429s after plan-sync. Started ~2026-03-07T10:24Z. High p50 latency and ~25-40% of requests 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0. Tenant: tenant-nimbus-01. Affects text-gen endpoints. Posting headers + config snapshot next.

luke_oncall: Can you paste a sample request id + the X-rate headers and the plan-sync timestamp? Also which autoscale profile is attached?

support_jen: Req id: rq_0a3b9c. Headers: X-Request-Id=rq_0a3b9c, X-RateLimit-Policy=per_tenant_60m, X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, X-Pool=reserved-west-3-quiet. Plan-sync completed 2026-03-07T10:24:12Z. Copy of the quota entry we pushed: 
```
policy: per_tenant_60m
limits:
  tokens: 60000
  window: 60m
  denom: min
```

maria_ops: Thanks. I'm seeing the migration job logs around 10:24 — it converted the plan entries and wrote a derived ratekey: `per_tenant_3600s` for some tenants but `per_tenant_60s` for others. Odd.

raj_eng: That hints at a unit-parsing bug in the plan-sync tool. The parser regex assumes units (s/m/h) but our mapping accidentally had 'm' -> 1 instead of 60 when the field was missing another flag. Reproduced locally: parsing `60m` returned 60 (seconds) not 3600.

support_jen: Oof. So tenants ended up with a 60s window instead of 60 minutes for some ratekeys. That would explain the oscillation and bursts causing 429s. Is there a quick mitigation?

maria_ops: Short-term: we can add a tenant-level override for tenant-nimbus-01, bumping quota to 6000 tokens per minute (temporary). Also we can increase soft-limits on reserved-west-3-quiet for the next 30m to absorb the spike.

raj_eng: I'll prepare a hotfix for the parser: change unit_map = {'s':1,'m':60,'h':3600} and add tests. Also a migration script to scan ratekeys with suspicious windows (< 300 && original_str contains 'm') and multiply by 60.

deploy-bot: deploy-started patch/ops/fix-rateunit-parse -> canary -> reserved-west-3-quiet

luke_oncall: Deploy ETA? Keep grafana snapshots handy. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/quietpool/quiet-pool-overview (shared)

support_jen: Tenant override applied at 2026-03-07T10:45Z. Error rate dropped from ~32% -> 2% within 5m. Customer rep (nimbus_cx) confirms reduced errors. :tada:

nimbus_cx: Confirming — traffic looks normal now, thanks. We'll monitor for a few hours and report back if anything else pops up.

raj_eng: PR opened + migration script in plan. I'll run migration in staging and then prod once canary looks good. Repro steps I used in staging: 
1) push plan-sync with `window: 60m`
2) spike 300 r/s against tenant header `X-Tenant: tenant-nimbus-01`
3) observe X-RateLimit-Remaining headers flip to 0 and 429s if parsed as 60s.

maria_ops: After deploy we increased soft limits for 30m and then lowered back. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and customer note.

support_jen: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open until migration applied and we confirm no other tenants effected. Will attach postmortem link when ready.
